2607.13413.title: Is the Statistical Advantage Worth the Cost? An Empirical Comparison of KANs and MLPs for Structured Data Classification
2607.13413.paper_summary: This study presents an empirical benchmarking comparison between Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) and Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) on structured tabular classification tasks. Motivated by the growing interest in KANs as an alternative function-approximating architecture, we evaluate their out-of-the-box performance on twelve publicly available datasets spanning binary, multiclass, multilabel, and ordinal problems. Both models were trained under standardized preprocessing, architecture, and fixed hyperparameter settings, with performance assessed using test accuracy and F1-Score, paired hypothesis testing, and effect size analysis. Results show that KANs statistically outperform MLPs in binary and multiclass domains and achieve a significant aggregate advantage across all datasets. However, the observed medium effect size (d = -0.46) raises an important cost-benefit consideration: while KANs offer superior generalization through adaptive spline-based mappings, this advantage comes with substantially higher parameter and computational complexity relative to the MLP baseline. These findings suggest KANs are the preferred choice for high-precision applications, while MLPs remain a robust and efficient option for resource-constrained environments. Future work should extend this analysis to additional data modalities to further refine these architectural selection criteria.
2607.13413.paper_summary_zh: 這項研究呈現了Kolmogorov-Arnold網絡（KANs）與多層感知器（MLPs）在結構化表格分類任務上的實證基準比較。受到KANs作為替代函數近似架構的日益關注的驅動，我們評估了它們在十二個公開可用數據集上的即時性能，這些數據集涵蓋了二元、多類別、多標籤和序數問題。兩個模型在標準化的預處理、架構和固定的超參數設置下進行訓練，並使用測試準確率和F1分數、配對假設檢驗以及效應大小分析來評估性能。結果顯示，KANs在二元和多類別領域的統計表現優於MLPs，並在所有數據集上實現了顯著的整體優勢。然而，觀察到的中等效應大小（d = -0.46）提出了一個重要的成本效益考量：雖然KANs通過自適應樣條映射提供了更優的泛化能力，但這一優勢伴隨著相對於MLP基準顯著更高的參數和計算複雜性。這些發現表明，KANs是高精度應用的首選，而MLPs仍然是資源受限環境中的穩健和高效選擇。未來的工作應將這一分析擴展到其他數據模態，以進一步完善這些架構選擇標準。
